# Ragdoll Mail

> Free, open-source mail app for Mac and Windows with fast local search. It works with Tencent Exmail (腾讯企业邮箱), QQ Mail, 163, Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail and any IMAP mailbox. Mail stays on the user's computer and their own mail server.

- Why it exists: on many mailboxes, Tencent Exmail most of all, the server's own search is slow or wrong. On a real Exmail mailbox of 6,442 mails, Exmail's search returned 4,988 mails for any word, even a made-up one. Ragdoll Mail keeps a local SQLite full-text index (trigram, so Chinese, Japanese and Korean work) and returns only the matching mails, in under 0.1 s, also offline.
- Price: free, MIT license, no ads, no account, no server of ours.
- Platforms: macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows 10/11. No phone app. One mailbox per window.
- Safety: up to 30 s to undo a send; warns when the text says "attached" and nothing is attached, the subject is empty, or a placeholder such as [Name] is left. Send later.
- Setup: type the address and password. For a company domain the app reads the domain's MX records and fills in the servers for Tencent Exmail, Google Workspace, Alibaba Mail, NetEase enterprise mail, iCloud, Fastmail, Zoho and Yandex.
- Password: kept in macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager. Many mailboxes need an app password (Exmail: 客户端专用密码; QQ Mail and 163: 授权码).
- For AI assistants: the `ragdoll` command (install it from the app: Settings → Command line). Claude Code, Codex and other assistants that run commands can search, read, write and check drafts, and open a draft in the app. Nothing is sent until the person presses Send.
